episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.summary: Six teenagers, who were friends but broke up after the death of their friend Amy, come back together and discover that their parents aren't who they thought they were.

episodes.title: Rewind
episodes.summary: On the day that the teenagers find out what their parents are doing, Geoffrey deals with a threat to his power, Victor tries to perfect the box, Tina uses her magic staff to seal Amy's room, Frank ask Leslie for more influence in the Church, and Stacey makes brie.

episodes.title: Destiny
episodes.summary: After the events of the previous night, the teens split up to find evidence confirming their suspicions. Nico finds Tina's staff, and Gert and Chase find the dinosaur in the Yorkes' basement. Meanwhile, Catherine questions Molly about whether she was in Geoffrey's study or not.

episodes.title: Fifteen
episodes.summary: Victor tries to make up for his screw-up, while Gert and Karolina team up to prove their parents' innocence. Meanwhile, Nico prepares to go to the police and asks Alex to go with her.

episodes.title: Kingdom
episodes.summary: The teens chase after the abducted Alex and reveal their powers to each other. Meanwhile, Geoffrey avoids telling Catherine about Darius, and the parents get a new sacrifice.

episodes.title: Metamorphosis
episodes.summary: Jonah insists on attending the PRIDE gala at the Wizard Building, where the teens try to obtain the video evidence showing that their parents killed Andre and the others.

episodes.title: Refraction
episodes.summary: Jonah tells Leslie to bring PRIDE back together, but is unaware that Frank has learned part of the secret that Leslie is concealing. Meanwhile, Victor starts to revert to his old self as Jonah's treatment wears off, and Catherine tells the Yorkes what to do with Molly.

episodes.title: Tsunami
episodes.summary: Alex tells Nico more about Amy's apparent suicide. Meanwhile, PRIDE argues about how to bring Victor back to life, and Jonah gives them an ultimatum.

episodes.title: Doomsday
episodes.summary: The teens come together to stop their parents' plan to unleash a holocaust on LA.

episodes.title: Hostile
episodes.summary: After Jonah captures Karolina, the teens go on the run and then regroup to rescue their friend.

episodes.title: Gimme Shelter
episodes.summary: The kids take refuge on the streets after their parents have the police come after them. After Chase's Fistigons and the group's money is stolen, Alex goes back to Darius for cash but has to repay him with a favor. While chasing the Fistigon thief, the Runaways find a new hideout.

episodes.title: Radio On
episodes.summary: While Nico, Karolina, and Molly go to get the Staff of One from Tina, Chase tries to power up the Hostel and discuss their relationship with Gert. Meanwhile, Alex goes back to help Darius and get closer to Livvie.

episodes.title: Double Zeros
episodes.summary: Darius sets up Alex for betrayal, while Janet turns to James for help deciphering the Abstract. Meanwhile, the Runaways try to practice as a team but find themselves at odds without Alex there.

episodes.title: Old School
episodes.summary: The Runaways are suspicious of Topher, and he tries to prove himself by helping them break into Atlas Academy to get a computer processor that Alex needs. Meanwhile, Gert risks exposing the group to get her anxiety meds, the Yorkes try to determine if their serum against Jonah will work, and Jonah takes Karolina to find out about herself.

episodes.title: Rock Bottom
episodes.summary: While the Runaways deal with revelations about Topher's life and his addiction to the rocks, Frank and Leslie disagree about Jonah's interference in Karolina's life and Gert goes to extreme measure to get medication for her anxiety.

episodes.title: Bury Another
episodes.summary: After Robert's failed attempt to kill Jonah, the Deans tell Jonah that he'll have to get his own sacrifice. Meanwhile, rifts open up between Chase and Gert, and Nico and Karolina.

episodes.title: Last Rites
episodes.summary: The Runaways head to the site to stop the lift-off of Jonah's spaceship. PRIDE has their own plans, but the two sides must join forces if they have any hope of stopping the destruction of California.

episodes.title: Past Life
episodes.summary: After Jonah is apparently killed, PRIDE breaks up. Frank turns to Leslie for help, Geoffrey discovers that he has a new enemy, and the Runaways break into a hotel penthouse so that Alex can get evidence showing who killed Darius.

episodes.title: Big Shot
episodes.summary: Tina and Stacey start acting strangely as PRIDE realizes that they still need each other despite Jonah's death. Meanwhile, Gert and Old Lace get increasingly sick, and Karolina hears a mysterious voice in the Hostel calling to her.

episodes.title: Hostile Takeover
episodes.summary: While AWOL and his men lay siege to the Hostel, Gert and Old Lace's condition worsens and Chase turns to an unexpected source for help. Meanwhile, Leslie tries to dismantle the Church and meets surprising resistance.

episodes.title: Last Waltz
episodes.summary: After Gert and Chase escape the Yorkes, the Runaways decide to celebrate Molly's 15th birthday. However, Chase has plans of his own for afterward.

episodes.title: Earth Angel
episodes.summary: While Victor tries to demonstrate to Chase that PRIDE has changed its ways, Frank takes Karolina prisoner at the Crater and Susan has a change of heart.

episodes.title: Split Up
episodes.summary: On behalf of PRIDE, Chase gives the Runaways one last chance to come in. When they refuse, their parents come after them and the group is forced to split up... and not everyone makes it back to the Hostel.

episodes.title: Smoke and Mirrors
episodes.summary: Alex and Nico break into the Stein manor to rescue their friends, while Xavin and Molly lure the Magister and his family away. Dale reveals a new side to Gert's link to Old Lace, and Leslie learns more about the child she's carrying.

episodes.title: The Great Escape
episodes.summary: Janet tries to reunite Chase and Karolina with her in the Algorithm, while Alex tries to free them from the outside using the Abstract. Stacey pays a visit to Dale and Gert, and Xavin warns that the Runaways are still in danger.

episodes.title: Lord of Lies
episodes.summary: The Runaways suspect that the Son is among them. Leslie reaches out to her mother for advice, and Tina tests the portal.

episodes.title: Rite of Thunder
episodes.summary: Alex abducts Leslie as she goes into labor, and takes her to the one place where he thinks she'll be safe. Meanwhile, the Runaways prepare for final battle against the Gibborim family as the latter prepare to return to their home planet.

episodes.title: Enter the Dreamland
episodes.summary: The Runaways find themselves in the Dark Dimension, and set out to find their missing parents and Alex... before they lose their memories of their past lives.

episodes.title: Merry Meet Again
episodes.summary: After six months in the Dark Dimension, the Runaways return to LA and discover that a new phone fad has swept the city. Robert has a new girlfriend, Molly and Gert get new men in their lives, and Dale becomes part of the unwashed masses. Stacey and Victor go to an alien survivors' group meeting and then Victor offers Stacey a job.

episodes.title: Left-Hand Path
episodes.summary: Morgan thwarts the Runaways from warning the public about the Wizphones' influence. Geoffrey reveals his new allegiance, Molly reveals her powers to Bodhi, and Nico goes her own path to try and bring Alex back.

episodes.title: Devil's Torture Chamber
episodes.summary: Tawny and Tyrone arrive at the Hostel to investigate a disturbance in the Dark Dimension, and accompany Nico, Karolina, Gert, and Chase on a mission to rescue Alex.

episodes.title: The Broken Circle
episodes.summary: The remaining PRIDE parents help rescue Molly, and then help the Runaways find a way to contain Morgan once and for all.

episodes.title: Cheat the Gallows
episodes.summary: In 2022, Chase travels back to try and prevent Alex from killing their past selves... and ends up trying to keep Morgan from killing Gert.
